Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow Phineas, it's really beautiful up here!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yes! That was very kind of you to invite us to your grandparents' house. (A basketball flies by, and he ducks to avoid it) No fair! That almost hit me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Life's not fair. Earlier today I just missed hitting this kid with a basketball.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace. What are you up to today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'll probably try to bust you guys... again! And fail... again! And add another link on my summer-long chain of disappointment and regrets.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Oblivious) How about that, Ferb, Candace already knows what she's gonna do today!

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Soo uhh... how's the antique business?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ooh, it's just fine. You know, they have a saying in the antique business.

Name: Clyde
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What is what?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: The saying. That you use in the antique business.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, I don't use it. But there is one.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, dad! Hi, grandpa! We're not interrupting, are we?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: No, no! No, come in, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I were just talking about the time you build a balloon and won the most famous balloon race in history. Tell us that story again?

Name: Clyde
Dialog: Well, I went out to the barn, I built a balloon and I won the most famous balloon race in history.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: He makes history come alive.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. If you need us, we'll be out in the barn!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! Just look at all this great stuff. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P! After extensive research and computer data analysis we have concluded that the Tri-State Area is experiencing an unprecedented shortage of eggs. We need you to investigate. Good luck, Agent P.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You there! Weren't you listening? Go make some eggs!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Whoa! Whoa, whoa, whoa, stop! You might wanna use the sugar unless you want salty lemonade!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, I can't wait to get new contacts. I'm as blind as a bat without them.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Here, use my spare set of glasses.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow, now everything is a different kind of blurry.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Hey, stranger. Come on in. Everyone, you remember Glenda?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Of course! Candace, Glenda was the first female train conductor in the entire Tri-State Area!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: But alas, the train is being decommissioned. And today is Glenda's last trip.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: And you know what? I'm gonna take her up Gearheart Summit.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: (gasps) But nobody's ever taken a train up Gearheart Summit, it's too steep!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Well, that's what they say, but I'm not one to give up!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: It's just like when you became a conductor.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: That's right. They told me to give up! (Candace is interested.) But I never give up! (Candace smiles a little.) I'm not the kind of person to give up! (Candace smiles more.) Well, I'm gonna prove that an old train can make it up those tracks. You guys wanna come with me?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: We should all go.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sounds like fun!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Okay! Train leaves the station at ten sharp! See you there!

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Isn't she something, Candace? That's a woman who would never give up!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: (echoing in Candace's memory) Give up! Blah blah! Give up! Blah blah blah blah blah! Give up! Blah blah blah! Give up!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's so simple! I don't know how I didn't think of it before!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'll give up!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's right, I never even suited up, folks!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I threw the baby out with the bathwater!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I forgot the Alamo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not even going for the bronze!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm staying right here, man.

Name: Candace
Dialog: In this hammock. I like it. Aw, it's beautiful, man.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay everyone, let's get this race started. Contact!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Last one at the top of the mountain is a stinky dish sponge!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha dooooin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: About... five knots.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Thought so, I'm doing six! See you at the summit, slowpokes!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, we're falling behind! What's happening?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Excess weight seems to be hampering our progress.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, we gotta lighten the load. (throws Baljeet out of the basket)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aaah, aah! How does dangling me from a rope lighten our load?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Eh, it lightens my spirit.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (hitting various obstacles) Ow! Ow, ow ow!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Mountain lion! (mountain lion roars)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Aaah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Well, I guess it serves me right for bringing work on vacation with me. Aaand there it is. (Perry is trapped in a egg-shaped container) Man, are we in a rut. Anyway, this is my Dodo-Bird-Incubator... you know... -inator. With this amazing device I can transform any egg to a Dodo egg. Once they hatch I will march my terrifying Dodo bird army across the Tri-State Area. You know, I don't really know what they look like, but they're extinct like dinosaurs, so just imagine! Giant, extinct dinosaur-like monsters laying waste to the city! Ah, you know, you, you really picked me up out of my doldrums.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: Well, we're here and ready to help, what would you like us to do?

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Just sit back and enjoy the view, the train will do all the work.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do nothing? Got that covered.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: All aboard! Gearheart Summit, here we come!

Name: Orville Wilkins
Dialog: You'll never make it! You should give up!

Name: Wilbur Wilkins
Dialog: Yeah, give up, woo-hoo!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: So long boys, and don't forget to clean your rooms!

Name: Orville/Wilbur
Dialog: Yes, mom.

Name: Orville
Dialog: It's your fault.

Name: Wilbur
Dialog: Quiet, you!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Looks like a dead heat so far.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We need to pick up the pace.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Alright, I'll get rid of this. (throws a taxidermied marlin away)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I do not know why you even brought the swordfish!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a marlin.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh no...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Little help, guys!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So Candace, you sure seem relaxed. What's up? (behind her, the kids in their balloons can be seen through the window)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm just taking in the ride and not worrying about what Phineas and Ferb are up to.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well good for you, honey. Cause I've got gin.

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: We're playing Kings Corners.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Are we?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's working! (the egg begins to hatch) It's wonderful! It's amazing! It's...! (giant dodo bird hatches)

Name: Dodo
Dialog: Narg narg narg! Narg!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's... (sighs) not quite as terrifying as I hoped.

Name: Dodo
Dialog: Narg!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: How am I supposed to take over the Tri-State Area with a bunch of these? Uh where's the horror, the terror, where's the- (Perry gets out of his trap) Oh nooo! Well, you know you're gonna have to wait in line, Perry the Platypus! First I gotta deal with this! I mean, this looks like a turkey, it's like Thanksgiving. (Dodo bird pecks Doofenshmirtz furiously) It's EXACTLY like Thanksgiving!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Glenda, how's it going?

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Mighty fine! You're looking chipper.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh yeah, I've been feeling great ever since I decided to heed your advice and give up.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Come again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, all summer I've been stressing about busting my brothers, but after your speech this morning I just gave up. And now I'm much more relaxed.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: So what you got from my speech about how you should never give up is that you should give up?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you did say "give up" a lot.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: I did say that, didn't I.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, Glenda? Glenda! The train is slowing down.

Name: Glenda
Dialog: So it is. I guess we're out of coal. (sits down) Oh well.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? You can't give up! No coal means no steam, and no steam means we can't make up the hill!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Meh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We gotta do something! We need fuel! Wait! I have an idea that just might work. And don't think I don't know what you're up to. I'll be right back.

Name: Linda
Dialog: She's such an active child.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just out of curiosity, what's going to happen to this train after today?

Name: Glenda
Dialog: It'll be torn apart and sold for scrap, why?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No reason.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What are we playing again?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey Phineas, what'cha doin' over there?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: My steering is a little loose, I think that- (stops, looks behind)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (suddenly standing next to Phineas) Do you need some help?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yeah. Can you hold the wheel while I tighten it?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (holds it) Gladly!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, that's perfect.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it is.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Check it out! A dodo bird! What's next on the list, Ferb?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (crossing off a list of the title sequence) Frankenstein's brain.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeeeah, uh, that was in my balloon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Woo-hoo! Yes, we made it! I knew we could, I knew we could, I knew we could!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: Oh, did you now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and you can drop the act. I know you didn't forget to bring coal. It's probably all in that box you're sitting on. But...lesson learned, and as long as I'm no longer giving up, I'm gonna go bust Phineas and Ferb. (jumps through the window) Thanks!

Name: Glenda
Dialog: I could've forgot the coal! (beat) I'm old!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Do you notice anything different here?

Name: Betty Jo
Dialog: OH yeah! Everything's half off at the gift shop!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here we are! Gearheart Summit. Let's put them down over there, Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looking at Ferb's outfit in the gift shop) Why is it every store sells this outfit? (notices the balloons) Mom, mom! Look what Phineas and Ferb are doing! Come quick! (points at the outfits and the head-shaped balloons behind them) Look, look! Right there! You see?! You see?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay Candace. (adjusts the glasses)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hello, boys. (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...What? (turns around) No!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A-ha! (runs to the balloon)

Name: Dodo
Dialog: Narg, narg, narg, narg! (runs into the second balloon)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sayonara, dodo! (both balloons take off) Hey, how'd you start that with no opposable thumbs?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look, it's just forced perspective, look! They're not really here! (The real Phineas and Ferb come over.) It's an optical illusion! He's not really --

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hi, Candace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aaah!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: How was the train ride?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pause) Oh, I give up. (walks away)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Some vacation this turned out to be. (the dodo makes a hole in his balloon)

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: So you bought a Museum of Biological Oddities, but you didn't get any biological oddities?(Doofenshmirtz falls through the roof)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Huh. What? (dodo falls in and lands on him)

Name: Farmer's Wife
Dialog: There it is!

Name: Dodo
Dialog: Narg narg narg! Narg!
